rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, but it overstates confidence in hatching/stage 4-5 features from this image and describes TE/ICM quality somewhat more favorably than is clearly visible on a single focal plane.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, uterine factor, smoking, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about uterine factor and smoking; only minor overreach in linking image appearance to exact expansion stage.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor issue is some speculative discussion of hydrosalpinx without case confirmation.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including uterine cavity evaluation, lifestyle modification, luteal support confirmation, and future-cycle considerations.
